summary: @ornikar/kitt2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's npm `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscated bootstrap that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to invoke a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727 KB heavily-obfuscated script (shuffled numeric/string array with a rotation function; no readable source). Both the bootstrap and the payload use obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming and control-flow dispatch. Executing an opaque sibling script via a freshly-downloaded alternate language runtime at install time bypasses Node-based static analysis and grants the payload native-tier capability on the installer's machine on `npm install`. The package presents itself as a Tamagui/React-Native UI component library and references the legitimate `github.com/ornikar/kitt` repository, but the preinstall dropper and the obfuscated payload are not part of the upstream ornikar design-system codebase, consistent with a hijack or typosquat of the `@ornikar/kitt*` namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
